texte: This is Ethan. He's sixteen. And from today, you control his life. Every episode is one year. Real odds decide what happens. And if he dies... it's over.
First big test: the driver's license. Only one in four American sixteen-year-olds has one. Spin.
He passes! Summer. He needs money. Just over one in three teens had a job this summer. Spin.
Rejected. So he drives his friends around. At night. Mile for mile, teen drivers get into deadly crashes almost three times more than adults. And tonight... a pickup runs the red light.
Every year, we spin the wheel of death. At sixteen, the odds are about one in fourteen hundred.
Your turn. He's seventeen. A: he buys a cheap car. B: any job, even nights. C: no car, just school. Comment A, B, or C. The most voted happens in episode two. Follow, so you don't miss his next year.
